# Vendored AntV G6

This directory contains the browser UMD bundle for `@antv/g6` version 5.1.1.

The frontend loads this local file instead of a CDN URL so the modeling canvas
does not silently fall back to the old DOM/SVG renderer when external network
access is unavailable.

Source:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@antv/g6@5.1.1/dist/g6.min.js
